import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the cblas_zhemm function
try:
    cblas_zhemm = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so').cblas_zhemm
    cblas_zhemm.argtypes = [ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int,
                            ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_void_p,
                            ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_int]
except AttributeError:
    raise RuntimeError("The cblas_zhemm function is not available in the loaded library.")

# Constants for CBLAS_ORDER, CBLAS_SIDE, CBLAS_UPLO
CBLAS_ORDER = {'RowMajor': 101, 'ColMajor': 102}
CBLAS_SIDE = {'Left': 141, 'Right': 142}
CBLAS_UPLO = {'Upper': 121, 'Lower': 122}

# Function to perform Hermitian matrix-matrix multiplication
def hermitian_matrix_multiply(order, side, uplo, M, N, alpha, A, lda, B, ldb, beta, C, ldc):
    alpha_c = np.array([alpha], dtype=np.complex128)
    beta_c = np.array([beta], dtype=np.complex128)
    A_c = np.array(A, dtype=np.complex128)
    B_c = np.array(B, dtype=np.complex128)
    C_c = np.array(C, dtype=np.complex128)

    # Ensure matrices are contiguous in memory
    A_c = np.ascontiguousarray(A_c)
    B_c = np.ascontiguousarray(B_c)
    C_c = np.ascontiguousarray(C_c)

    cblas_zhemm(CBLAS_ORDER[order], CBLAS_SIDE[side], CBLAS_UPLO[uplo], M, N,
                alpha_c.ctypes.data, A_c.ctypes.data, lda, B_c.ctypes.data, ldb,
                beta_c.ctypes.data, C_c.ctypes.data, ldc)
    return C_c

# Test cases
def assert_test():
    # Test case 1
    M, N = 2, 2
    alpha = 1+0j
    beta = 0+0j
    A = [[1+0j, 2+0j], [2+0j, 3+0j]]
    B = [[4+0j, 5+0j], [6+0j, 7+0j]]
    C = [[0+0j, 0+0j], [0+0j, 0+0j]]
    lda, ldb, ldc = 2, 2, 2
    result = hermitian_matrix_multiply('RowMajor', 'Left', 'Upper', M, N, alpha, A, lda, B, ldb, beta, C, ldc)
    expected = np.array([[16+0j, 19+0j], [26+0j, 31+0j]], dtype=np.complex128)
    assert np.allclose(result, expected), f"Test case 1 failed: {result} != {expected}"

    # Test case 2
    M, N = 2, 2
    alpha = 1+0j
    beta = 1+0j
    A = [[1+0j, 2+0j], [2+0j, 3+0j]]
    B = [[4+0j, 5+0j], [6+0j, 7+0j]]
    C = [[1+0j, 1+0j], [1+0j, 1+0j]]
    lda, ldb, ldc = 2, 2, 2
    result = hermitian_matrix_multiply('RowMajor', 'Left', 'Upper', M, N, alpha, A, lda, B, ldb, beta, C, ldc)
    expected = np.array([[17+0j, 20+0j], [27+0j, 32+0j]], dtype=np.complex128)
    assert np.allclose(result, expected), f"Test case 2 failed: {result} != {expected}"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
